title: Paul McCartney live: Electric Ballroom, London | 2007
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Electric Ballroom in London, England, on 7 June 2007.

It was the first show of the Secret Tour, which lasted for just six dates between June and October 2007 in promotion of the Memory Almost Full album.

This concert was seen by 1,000 fans. Tickets sold out within minutes of being announced.

Embed from Getty Images

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).
